scope: Retire the three legacy KPI high-level sources before they are deleted from BigQuery.
method: Live BigQuery inventory and schema comparison against the active marketing KPI daily, MTD, and monthly sources.

rham_kpi_highlevel_dly.reason: Legacy daily KPI source is being retired. Use the active marketing KPI daily source and its current column contract.
rham_kpi_highlevel_dly.evidence: Both tables were present in BigQuery on 2026-09-21. The replacement covers 2024-01-01 through 2026-09-19 and exposes the current 40-column daily schema.

rham_kpi_highlevel_mtd.reason: Legacy MTD KPI source is being retired. Use the active marketing high-level MTD source.
rham_kpi_highlevel_mtd.evidence: The replacement was present in BigQuery on 2026-09-21, covers month_id 202401 through 202609, and provides 184 columns including dt_id_snapshot.

rham_kpi_highlevel_mth.reason: Legacy monthly KPI source is being retired. Use the active marketing high-level monthly source.
rham_kpi_highlevel_mth.evidence: The replacement was present in BigQuery on 2026-09-21, covers month_id 202401 through 202609, and provides 168 columns including dt_id_snapshot.
